svg.text: Ongoing and Completed cannot be deactivated — Inactive is reachable only from Undefined, Unapproved, Defined, Ready and ForReview.
persists through execution — no approval step, no separate withdrawal

Setting Ready is the trigger request; the database keeps the row in step, so the state and the trigger cannot disagree. Unapproved, and the routes in and out of it, behave exactly as in Phase 2 above.
A warned ToO offers only ForReview, which does not fire the trigger; staff can still force Ready via the unadvertised override.
Undefined and Unapproved are unreachable: validationStatus is pinned to Defined, which is both the entry point and the floor. Warnings never occur, so neither is ForReview.
Per-observation calibrations — inherit their science observation's user state
inherited — no transitions of its own
